name: pause-bars
note: The pause menu's status page on a wide screen: the bars of its rows (Poison, Curse and the rest) run off the screen's right edge, as they ran off a 4:3 screen's. The game draws them 30 pixels past the console frame's right edge, and in widescreen they ended in the air beside the 4:3 middle (found by the judge in October, about 35 pixels out at 960 wide). Their vertices past the frame's edge now go to the screen's (widescreen.cpp, ext.z 5). With the menu's columns left in the middle (menu_spread off), where the bars ended well short of the screen's edge: at the edge the first row's bright band and the dark of the next row's top, which were both the backdrop's grey before. And the screen's last column is in step with the rows it ends: the frame pass, placed a pixel up and left, left that column to the frame under it, the same picture a pixel lower, which a bar's edge showed as a step down at the screen's edge (the third row's, two rows of pixels at 960 by 540: 56 brighter there than beside it, now within 20). As pause-bars-spread with the columns moved out (the default).
